meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按代码结构(而非字面文本)在 25 种语言里搜索和改写代码:找出某类函数、调用或导入,把 console.log 换成 logger.info,或按 YAML 规则扫描。改写默认先预览、再应用。
howto.when: 当需求取决于代码语法结构而非文本字节时触发:查找形如 X 的函数、调用、导入等,或做跨文件代码改写。纯文本、注释、文件名请改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有形如 console.log($MSG) 的调用
say.note: 只列出匹配位置,不改文件

say.text: 把所有 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x),先预览
say.note: 默认干跑,加 --apply 才落盘

say.text: 扫描 src/ 下的 YAML 规则并报告违规
say.note: 发现 sgconfig.yml 后运行全部规则

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can search and rewrite code by AST shape across 25 languages — finding calls, classes, or imports shaped like X, rewriting console.log to logger.info, or scanning YAML rules. Rewrites preview first by default.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is a syntax pattern rather than text: every function, call, or import shaped like X, or a codemod. For strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

say_en.text: Find every call shaped like console.log($MSG)
Rewrite all console.log(x) to logger.info(x), preview first
Scan src/ with the YAML rules and report violations
say_en.note: Finds sgconfig.yml and runs all rules
